annotation.title_clean: ロボット介護機器開発のための安全ハンドブック
annotation.title_en: Safety Handbook for the Development of Robotic Nursing-Care Devices
annotation.authors_or_issuer: AMED ロボット介護機器開発・導入促進事業 基準策定評価コンソーシアム (AIST, JNIOSH, JARI, JQA, JASPEC, Nagoya University)
annotation.venue: AMED Robotic Devices for Nursing Care Project
annotation.summary_en: Japanese AMED consortium handbook giving developers of robotic nursing-care devices risk-assessment templates, protective measures, safety verification items mapped to ISO 13482, and newly developed safety test methods (EMC, pacemaker interference, human-contact force limits, stability, durability) across eight priority device types.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adopts ISO 12100 three-step risk reduction with R=S×(F+Ps+A) hybrid risk estimation and ALARP thresholds.
Applies ISO 13482 plus type-B standards, since no standard directly covers nursing-care robots.
Recommends keeping robot output below 300 N to avoid caregiver upper-limb fracture.
Provides test methods for EMC/pacemaker interference, power-loss lock delay, stability, durability and fall-precursor detection.
Residual risk must be communicated to users, but developers are not exempt from PL Act liability.
